title: 3348. Smallest Divisible Digit Product II

examples.explanation: The smallest zero-free number that is greater than 1234 and has the product of its digits divisible by 256 is 1488, with the product of its digits equal to 256.
12355 is already zero-free and has the product of its digits divisible by 50, with the product of its digits equal to 150.
No number greater than 11111 has the product of its digits divisible by 26.
